description: Same as E3_ternary_ft_5k (alpha=0, CE only, 5000 steps, body ternary + INT8 per-token activations, io FP) but per-channel ternary scale: W ~ diag(gamma) T, gamma = mean|w| per output row.
conclusion: Per-channel scale lowers holdout TF loss (0.195 vs 0.204 per-tensor) but full-test solve rate is unchanged (71.80 vs 71.60, difference << 1 SE). Finer weight scaling does not close the gap. Holdout is part of the official FP model's training data; compare only ternary runs with each other on it.
note: Transcribed from pasted Colab log. Single seed.
